tools.name: lookup_hts_code
tools.description: Search the official USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule by keyword or HTS number. Returns codes with general, special and column 2 rates.

tools.name: calculate_import_duty
tools.description: Base HTS duty for an 8/10-digit code, ISO-2 country of origin and customs value. Applies Column 2 for CU/KP/RU/BY and FTA special rates where the HTS lists the country's program. Ad valorem rates only; Chapter 99 additional duties are not included.

tools.name: lookup_chapter99_duties
tools.description: Official HTS Chapter 99 provisions (Section 301, 232, IEEPA and other additional duties) from the USITC schedule, filtered by country_of_origin (ISO-2), keyword, heading prefix (e.g. 9903.88) and/or an HTS code's footnote references.
